title: Tech Note: Static Web Serving 101
author: Darrell Draper, Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: Web Root / default home page configuration

historical_commentary.text: This foundational primer on serving static HTML content with the 4D built-in Web Server (Web Root, URL structure, caching, compression) covers concepts that remain accurate today, since 4D's Web Server still serves static content the same fundamental way; basic HTTP concepts like caching and compression are timeless and unaffected by any subsequent 4D architectural change. That said, static-site hosting has largely moved to CDNs/static hosts for pure static content in modern web architecture generally, and within 4D applications, static content is now more often served alongside REST/ORDA-backed dynamic APIs rather than as the primary interface.
